name: speech
title: Speech
summary: Your team hear you and answer with a voice: on the dashboard and on Telegram. Whisper and Kokoro run on your computer, or a cloud service you choose.

manifest.name: speech
manifest.description: Lets agents listen to an audio file and answer with a voice, through the OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible account you choose on Settings → Speech, or Whisper and Kokoro on this computer, with daily limits.

network.why: OpenAI accounts: a recording goes to be transcribed, or a text to be spoken; the text or the audio comes back.
Install on Settings → Speech: the Whisper and Kokoro model files, pinned and checked; nothing is sent.
Hugging Face's download servers (us.aws.cdn.hf.co and its like), where huggingface.co sends those files.
Install of Kokoro: the eSpeak NG package (12.5 MB, GPL-3.0), pinned and checked, which pronounces the languages other than English; nothing is sent.

tools.name: speech.transcribe
tools.description: Turn a recording from the Files library (a voice note, an audio file up to 25 MB) into text. With a cloud service the recording leaves this machine for the listening service the owner chose in Settings → Speech (OpenAI or their OpenAI-compatible server), which sends back the text; with Whisper on this computer nothing leaves. Returns { text, language? }.

tools.name: speech.say
tools.description: Say a text aloud and keep the audio in the owner's Files library (a voice note, OGG/Opus when the service gives it). With a cloud service the text leaves this machine for the speaking service the owner chose in Settings → Speech (OpenAI or their OpenAI-compatible server), which sends back the audio; with Kokoro on this computer nothing leaves, and it speaks English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Hindi (the voice follows the text's language). Write for the ear.

tools.name: speech.set_settings
tools.description: The Speech settings. The owner's own.

tools.name: speech.test
tools.description: Try the chosen listening service on a short clip. The owner's own.

tools.name: speech.preview
tools.description: Play a short sample of a speaking service and voice on the Speech page; nothing is kept. The owner's own.

tools.name: speech.install
tools.description: Download a speech model to run on this computer, in the background. The owner's own.

tools.name: speech.remove
tools.description: Delete a speech model downloaded to this computer. The owner's own.

tools.name: speech.telegram_voice
tools.description: Voice replies on Telegram: when, and what is sent. The owner's own.

skills.name: speaking-for-the-ear
skills.description: How to write a reply that will be spoken: short sentences, no tables or markdown, numbers as people say them. Read it before calling speech.say.
